findings.description: Direct inspection of all five V135 views and six poses: added crest topology produces no material visual improvement; pleats remain weak at viewing scale and the skirt reads as a smooth flared shell with angular surface patches and side lobing. Change the sewn-panel pleat construction and resolve intersections and shading discontinuities, then regenerate all required views and poses.

V135 front, side, and rear views retain an abrupt projecting skirt-to-waist edge, most visible in profile, with the upper boundary forming a shelf. Reconcile the upper edge and waist contour, then verify front, back, and both sides.

V135 crouch and sit still show shorts and thighs above the skirt front while panels bunch below and behind the legs; prone retains a broad crumpled fan with overlapping folds. Correct panel coverage and deformation, then directly inspect all eleven required renders.
